npve01.title: POV: you're dating an Aries.
npve01.caption: Dating an Aries: you say maybe, they're already outside. Fast to the corner, patient at every crossing.

npve02.title: POV: you're dating a Taurus.
npve02.caption: Never reach for a Taurus's cake. They might have ordered your own slice before you even asked.

npve03.title: POV: you're dating a Gemini.
npve03.caption: Dating a Gemini: three stories, no endings, five new nicknames. Then every tangent turns out to be about you.

npve04.title: POV: you're dating a Cancer.
npve04.caption: A Cancer packs snacks for a four-minute walk. On a rough day they don't try to fix it. They just stay close and listen.

npve05.title: POV: you're dating a Leo.
npve05.caption: A Leo will stop posing in the mirror just to tell you that you look amazing. Then pull you into the frame.

npve06.title: POV: you're dating a Virgo.
npve06.caption: A Virgo notices the onions you always pick out. They also keep the napkin you doodled a heart on.

npve07.title: POV: you're dating a Libra.
npve07.caption: Two people, one dessert, a Libra with a ruler. Split perfectly fair, then they slide you the extra bite.

npve08.title: POV: you're dating a Scorpio.
npve08.caption: That Scorpio stare across the table? Deep questions, zero small talk, and secretly just as nervous as you.

npve09.title: POV: you're dating a Sagittarius.
npve09.caption: Ask a Sagittarius and you get the honest answer. About your hat, their cooking, and how much they like you.

npve10.title: POV: you're dating a Capricorn.
npve10.caption: Your Capricorn arrives early with your coffee and a five-year plan for the houseplant. Year five? Still you.

npve11.title: POV: you're dating an Aquarius.
npve11.caption: An Aquarius won't buy you a gift. They'll build one that pours cocoa very slowly. Weird and sweet is the point.

npve12.title: POV: you're dating a Pisces.
npve12.caption: Dating a Pisces: tears at the trailer, tears over one shared fry, and the tissues ready when you cry too.

npve13.title: POV: you're dating an Aries. Snow day.
npve13.caption: An Aries builds a snowman in four seconds. Then builds a little one for you and waits while you add the nose.

npve14.title: POV: you're dating a Taurus. Holiday market.
npve14.caption: Take a Taurus to a holiday market and they'll taste every sample. Mention the one you liked and they buy the box.

npve15.title: POV: you're dating a Gemini. The holiday party.
npve15.caption: Your Gemini knows everyone at the party. Their favourite conversation of the night is still the quiet one with you.

npve16.title: POV: you're dating a Cancer. The ornament.
npve16.caption: A Cancer hands you a slightly lopsided ornament they made. Then shows you its twin, already hanging on their family's tree.

npve17.title: POV: you're dating a Leo. The lights.
npve17.caption: Date a Leo in December and the house lights get very bright. Then they rearrange to spell one word: YOU.
